text: Westport Albion begins with Kian Castillo intercepting the ball near the center of the pitch, about 22 metres from their own goal. He quickly moves the ball forward through a series of short, precise passes with teammates along the right flank and center, advancing steadily into Kingsmoor FC’s defensive third. Castillo then provides a short, angled pass to Rafael Delacroix, who is positioned just 4.6 metres from the goal on the left side of the penalty area in front of Kingsmoor’s net. Delacroix takes a footed shot and scores, bringing the score to Kingsmoor FC 2, Westport Albion 1 [#391] [#398] [#401].
